Receipts

After-only. The intended before-receipts capture was lost (a Settings page was saved in that slot and discarded). Do not treat this as a matched pair.

What changed, and why

On-time rate includes overdue gear

Was

Return record used completed checkouts only, so a person with overdue gear could still show 100% or a high green bar.

Now

After three episodes, on-time rate is on-time completed checkouts divided by completed plus currently overdue PERSON checkouts. Open overdue work counts as not on time.

Filters stay in the URL

Was

Year, location, incident state, user state, and sort lived only in React state, so a refresh or shared link reset the board.

Now

Those filters sync to the query string. The current academic year is written as year=2026 when it is selected. Person search stays local and does not change rank, metrics, or the spotlight.

You can find yourself

Was

Eighteen rows and no way to jump to the signed-in viewer.

Now

You’re #N jumps to the row. A You badge marks it. Find a person filters the table in place.

Red means gear is still out

Was

Every late-event count used a red badge, including All returned rows.

Now

Red badges are reserved for people who still have overdue gear. Resolved counts stay quiet gray.

CSV stays on the page

Was

Export ranking assigned window.location and navigated away.

Now

ADMIN CSV downloads in place through the shared report-export path. Rate limit and permission run before report work.

Receipts and ranking labels

Was

Rank by Volume / Time / Recent. Incident badges competed with dates. Exclude was easy to miss. Active overdue receipts could sit under resolved ones.

Now

Rank by Events / Time / Latest. Active overdue receipts sort first. Exclude is a labeled button. Item summaries load only for incident rows so the warm path stays under a second.

  • Focused tests: tests/accountability-service.test.ts, tests/accountability-routes.test.ts, tests/accountability-page-source.test.ts. 32 tests across 4 files, then the page-source file again at 5/5, all pass.
  • npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false: pass
  • eslint on the accountability page, client, spotlight, API route, and service: pass
  • git diff --check on those accountability paths: pass
  • npm run build:app: skipped. Preview was already bound to 127.0.0.1:3000; the repo guard refuses a Next compile while that port is in use.
  • Authenticated Preview as Erik Role ADMIN, dark appearance, /accountability then /accountability?year=2026. Live board: 18 people, 39 late events, 9 currently overdue. Nolan 64% with overdue gear; David 80% with a gray count after returns. You’re #12 lands on Erik Role at 92%. Search Erik keeps the spotlight and metrics. Exclude on FB vs Notre Dame (Neutral) is a labeled button. CSV download was exercised in-session and stayed on the page.
  • Warm GET /api/accountability ~761ms after the two-phase item-summary load. One later resource was ~7.3s, likely a compile, not the warm path.

Things to know

  • Receipts are after-only because the baseline capture in that slot was a Settings page and was discarded.
  • Before and after page shots are not a hash-validated pair: after writes year=2026 into the URL.
  • The before screenshot predates the accountability patch; its capture receipt was recorded later and uses the after patch hash as workspace provenance, not as proof that the before pixels came from that patch.
  • Unrelated dirty work (schedule activity, settings sub-pages, app chrome) was left untouched. A sidebar hydration warning from data-cursor-ref is from that other work.
  • Do not run npm run build while Preview occupies :3000.
  • Person search is local only and is not written to the URL.
